verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Auto Drafts 2.0 can pull from your calendar and insert your availability into email drafts, and users can tell the scheduling features to "use this booking link". So the product does put availability and booking links into emails itself. However, the evidence only shows this happening inside AI-generated drafts. There is no documented manual way to insert availability while composing. missing for 10: a user-invoked insert-availability or bookable-time-slot action in the composer, detail on how inserted times are formatted or made bookable, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email

citations.quote: They can use information from other emails, insert availability, and conduct research online.
Add plain-language instructions like "write in lowercase" or "use this booking link" to personalize your writing and scheduling features.
Each draft can use your inbox, calendar, and the web to write replies that are ready to send.
